evidence.note: The chaise backrest is flat while the user's hand approaches it.
The hinged backrest is visibly being raised.
The backrest is upright and stable.
The backrest remains raised.
The user grasps the raised backrest to lower it.
The chaise is flat again.

events.object_description: Adjustable backrest of the white balcony chaise lounge; on means raised and off means flat.

evidence.note: The grill's main cooking lid is closed.
The user is lifting the main lid by its handle.
The cooking lid is fully open, exposing the grates.
The lid remains open.
The user grasps the open lid to close it.
The main lid is closed again.

events.object_description: Main hinged cooking lid of the stainless gas grill; on means open and off means closed.

evidence.note: The grill's lower propane cabinet is closed.
The lower door is being swung outward, revealing the propane cylinder.
The cabinet door is fully open.
The open cabinet and propane cylinder remain visible.
The user is closing the lower door by its handle.
The propane compartment is closed again.

events.object_description: Lower propane-cylinder cabinet door of the gas grill; on means open and off means closed.

evidence.note: The plain shelf on the sliding-door side is folded alongside the grill.
The user reaches to the shelf edge/support and begins raising it.
The plain metal shelf is horizontal and extended.
The extended shelf remains horizontal beside the grill.
The broad horizontal surface is gone and only the folded side profile remains.

events.object_description: Plain fold-down grill side shelf on the sliding-door side; on means horizontal/extended and off means folded down.

evidence.note: The red-labeled shelf on the trellis side is hanging folded alongside the grill.
The user's hand approaches the folded shelf.
The user is lifting the red-labeled shelf into position.
The shelf is horizontal and extended.
The red-labeled shelf remains extended horizontally.
The shelf is largely obscured during the close approach where lowering occurs.
The right shelf no longer projects horizontally and is folded alongside the grill.
Its red-labeled face is visible in the folded-down position.

events.object_description: Red-labeled fold-down grill side shelf on the trellis side; on means horizontal/extended and off means folded down.

notes: Five distinct localized manipulation episodes are visible. The two grill shelves are treated separately because they are independently manipulated parts on opposite sides of the grill. Shelf transition timing is less certain because of strong camera roll and brief occlusion.
scene_description: A user circles a covered apartment balcony containing a white adjustable chaise lounge and a stainless gas grill, manipulating the chaise backrest and several independent grill parts.
